import json
prog = currentProgram
out = {"sha256": str(prog.getExecutableSHA256())}
fm = prog.getFunctionManager()
# 1) symbols with DirtyTilePublisher
st = prog.getSymbolTable()
syms = []
it = st.getAllSymbols(True)
n = 0
while it.hasNext() and n < 200000:
    monitor.checkCancelled()
    sym = it.next()
    n += 1
    nm = str(sym.getName())
    if 'DirtyTilePublisher' in nm or 'dirty_tile_publish' in nm:
        a = sym.getAddress()
        f = fm.getFunctionAt(a)
        sz = f.getBody().getNumAddresses() if f else -1
        syms.append([nm, str(a), sz])
out["publish_syms"] = syms
# 2) callers of water_rasterize_from_cpu 0x140a12680
refmgr = prog.getReferenceManager()
addr = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress("0x140a12680")
callers = []
for r in refmgr.getReferencesTo(addr):
    monitor.checkCancelled()
    if not r.getReferenceType().isCall():
        continue
    ca = r.getFromAddress()
    cf = fm.getFunctionContaining(ca)
    callers.append([str(ca), str(cf.getEntryPoint()) if cf else "", str(cf.getName()) if cf else ""])
out["wrf_callers"] = callers
print(json.dumps(out))
